name: legal-document-analysis-portal
description: Production-ready legal document analysis and findings letter generation platform
author: Legal Technology Team

scripts.start: echo 'Please use the appropriate scripts in scripts/ directory'
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:backend && npm run deploy:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:frontend: cd frontend && python -m pytest tests/ -v || echo 'Frontend tests not yet implemented'
scripts.test:e2e: cd tests && python -m pytest e2e/ -v || echo 'E2E tests not yet implemented'
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && flake8 . || echo 'Install flake8 for linting'
scripts.lint:frontend: cd frontend && flake8 . || echo 'Install flake8 for linting'
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend
scripts.format:backend: cd backend && black . || echo 'Install black for formatting'
scripts.format:frontend: cd frontend && black . || echo 'Install black for formatting'
scripts.setup: npm run setup:env && npm run setup:deps
scripts.setup:env: cp config/.env.template .env && echo 'Please edit .env with your API keys'
scripts.setup:deps: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:frontend: cd frontend && python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install streamlit requests python-multipart
scripts.clean: npm run clean:build && npm run clean:cache
scripts.clean:cache: find . -type d -name '__pycache__' -exec rm -rf {} + || true && find . -type d -name '.pytest_cache' -exec rm -rf {} + || true
scripts.docker:build: npm run docker:build:backend && npm run docker:build:frontend
scripts.logs:backend: cd backend && tail -f *.log || echo 'No backend logs found'
scripts.logs:frontend: echo 'Frontend logs available in terminal where Streamlit is running'
